provenance: AIME 2024, OpenAI o1. The source's two scaling charts ('Learning to Reason with LLMs', Sept 2024) plot AIME pass@1 against log train-time and log test-time compute with the compute axes UNLABELED (relative units); both climb roughly log-linearly across about two visual decades, from roughly 20% to roughly 80%. Points here are an authored log-linear redrawing y = 21 + 29.5*log10(x), x = relative test-time compute in [1, 100], matching that visual span; slopes are illustrative of the figure's shape, NOT digitized values. Verbatim anchors from the source text: GPT-4o 12% on AIME (1.8/15); o1 74.4% pass@1, 83.3% with consensus among 64 samples, 93% re-ranking 1000 samples with a learned scorer; Codeforces Elo 808 (11th percentile) vs 1807 (89th); GPQA diamond 56.1 vs 78.0 (cons@64, from the headline figure), human PhD experts 69.7.
